read.thesis: RTX raised FY26 adjusted sales to $97–97.5B and EPS to $7.65–7.75 on a record $340B backlog, but gains lean on one-off IEEPA recovery and munitions capacity ramps need supplier build-out first.

capex.quote: we are making incremental investments in our supply chain and operations to ramp capacity support significantly higher production rates.

triggers.label: Backlog $340B, up 36% YoY
triggers.quote: RTX ended Q3 with another record backlog of $340 billion up 36% year over year and 18% sequentially.

triggers.label: Adj EPS guide $7.65–7.75 from $7.10–7.25
triggers.quote: We now see adjusted EPS between $7.65 and $7.75 for the full year, up from our prior range of $7.10 to $7.25.

triggers.label: Munitions output up 90% YoY
triggers.quote: Year to date, output across our critical munitions is up over 90% year over year

triggers.label: IEEPA recovery flatters Q3 margins
triggers.quote: Segment margins expanded 310 basis points year over year including the benefit of approximately 160 basis points from IEEPA.

guidance.quote: we are raising our full year adjusted sales outlook by $2 billion on the low end and $1.5 billion on the high end to a new range of $97 billion to $97.5 billion
We now see adjusted EPS between $7.65 and $7.75 for the full year, up from our prior range of $7.10 to $7.25.
we now expect free cash flow to be between $9.0 billion and $9.2 billion for the full year
we now expect growth between $925 million and $975 million versus 2025
We now expect sales to grow low teens on both an adjusted and organic basis.

red_flags.label: Q3 margin flattered by one-off IEEPA recovery
red_flags.quote: Segment margins expanded 310 basis points year over year including the benefit of approximately 160 basis points from IEEPA.

red_flags.label: Working capital build to support growth
red_flags.quote: we are gonna keep an eye on the need for probably a little bit higher working capital

red_flags.label: Pratt $363M customer bankruptcy charge
red_flags.quote: Customer Bankruptcy Charge -- $363 million pre-tax charge at Pratt & Whitney, primarily related to contract asset exposures.

evasions.topic: Munitions framework revenue cadence and 2027 contribution
evasions.quote: as I look at Raytheon's, you know, 2027 and beyond outlook, it shows very strong top line growth opportunity

evasions.topic: Share of GTF shop visits on pay-at-overhaul contracts
evasions.quote: the vast majority of them are at a pay and shop visit. Contract.
